 Backend Development

 \\- Develop highly reliable microservices and backend modules.
   

 \\- Implement authentication, authorization, user management, subscription, device management, threat intelligence, and security\\-related services.

 \\- Integrate third\\-party cybersecurity, identity, payment, insurance, notification, and other APIs.
   

 \\- Develop secure and efficient data\\-processing pipelines.
   

  

 Backend Architecture
   

  

 \\- Take ownership of the overall backend architecture.
   

 \\- Design scalable and fault\\-tolerant microservices.
   

 \\- Define service boundaries, API contracts, data models, and communication patterns.
   

 \\- Make appropriate decisions regarding synchronous and asynchronous processing.

 Database \\& Data Layer

 Cybersecurity

**You will be expected to:**
 \\- Follow secure coding practices.
   

 \\- Implement strong authentication and authorization mechanisms.
   

 \\- Protect APIs against common attacks.
   

 \\- Implement rate limiting, validation, logging, and abuse prevention.

 \\- Work with the security team to identify and resolve backend vulnerabilities.

 \\- Python\\-based AI/ML services.
   

 \\- AI inference APIs.
   

 \\- LLM and machine\\-learning services.
   

 \\- Speech/text processing services.
   

 \\- Threat detection engines.
   

 \\- RAG and threat\\-intelligence systems.
   

 \\- Communication between Go services and Python AI services.
   

  

 Kotlin / Android Integration

 \\- Android application architecture.
   

 \\- API consumption from Android.
   

 \\- Authentication/session flows.
   

 \\- Mobile\\-to\\-backend communication.
   

 \\- Push notifications.
   

 \\- Device and security\\-related data flows.
   

  

 You will primarily work on the backend, but this knowledge will help you collaborate effectively with the Android team.
   

  

 DevOps \\& Deployment

 \\- CI/CD pipelines.
   

 \\- Linux.
   

 \\- Cloud infrastructure such as AWS/Azure.

**Required Technical Skills**
 Must Have

 \\- GraphQL experience.

 \\- Threat intelligence or security API integration experience.
   

 \\- Experience building high\\-scale applications.
   

 \\- Experience with AI/ML service integration.
   

  

 Ideal Candidate
   

  

 The ideal candidate is someone who:

**Qualifications**

**What We Offer**
